lines.text: Stop saying this.
Many learners say: My bag is too much heavy.
Pause and guess. What sounds right?
Say: My bag is too heavy.
Too goes right before the adjective. No much.
Now at normal speed: My bag is too heavy.
Teacher's tip: save these lines.
Quiz: My suitcase is blank. Too heavy, or too much heavy? Comment below.
Check your grammar on lexkite.com.
Never say this.
Many learners say: My room card doesn't work.
Pause and guess. What sounds right?
Say: My key card doesn't work.
Hotel cards that open doors are key cards.
Now at normal speed: My key card doesn't work.
Teacher's tip: save these lines.
Quiz: Tap your blank card to open the door. Key, or room? Comment below.
Roleplay this free on lexkite.com.
Natives never say this.
Many learners say: Let's divide the bill.
Pause and guess. What sounds right?
Say: Let's split the bill.
For sharing a cost, we say split the bill.
Now at normal speed: Let's split the bill.
Teacher's tip: save these lines.
Quiz: Dinner was great. Let's blank the bill. Split, or divide? Comment below.
